result_fields.operation.state: accepted | in_progress | completed | refused | failed | indeterminate. Null outcome/reason means not yet known or not applicable; failed/completed is not inferred from exit 0.
result_fields.operation.stage: intent | applying | dispatching | settled; persistence/dispatch progress, not proof of provider delivery.
result_fields.operation.effects.reply: not_applicable | not_sent | submitted | delivered | unknown. submitted means provider input was written; delivered requires matching provider conversation evidence.
result_fields.operation.effects.session: not_started | starting | resumed | unknown. resumed requires a correlated saved attempt and provider start; it does not mean the phase finished.
result_fields.operation.effects.plan: not_advanced | advanced | unknown. advanced accepts completion once; it does not promise the next model turn started.
result_fields.operation.outcome: completed records resulting values in operation.settings; it does not start/resume work.
result_fields.operation.reason: Refusal/failure/uncertainty explanation, or null. A completed operation may still have a domain outcome requiring operator choice.
result_fields.operation.reply_text: Normalized literal accepted reply, or null for non-reply commands. A phase_already_complete reply stays not_sent and retained for the saved history lifetime.
result_fields.operation.acknowledged_by: ID of the explicit advance operation acknowledging an unsent reply, otherwise null. Text is retained and never sent by acknowledgement.
result_fields.operation.session_id: Kiln session selector when an attempt is correlated; optional, distinct from provider conversation ID.
result_fields.operation.phase_key: Recorded phase/audit/delivery storage key when correlated; optional.
result_fields.operation.attempt_id: Stable correlated attempt ID when dispatch exists; optional.
result_fields.operation.settings: Resulting keep_awake and resume_after_usage_limit booleans for settings operations; optional on other receipts.
result_fields.run_state: Current run state when live; last_known for a closed-controller receipt read. The operation retains its original execution_id across execution replacement.
result_fields.retry: After disconnect inspect command-status. An identical ID/token/inputs replays its receipt before current eligibility, including refusals. New intent or changed token/inputs needs a new ID.
